fullDescription: Professional political campaign design system inspired by Brazilian electoral visual identity. Features a patriotic and trust-evoking palette of deep navy blue (#004a8f), vibrant yellow (#fcd53f), and emerald green (#28a745). The typography utilizes ultra-heavy Montserrat for authority and rounded Nunito for accessibility. Design elements include layered SVG wave transitions, bento-grid value propositions, and marker-style text highlights. Ideal for civic leaders, public figures, NGOs, and community-driven initiatives needing a balance of institutional strength and grassroots approachability.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bold, institutional style guide centered on trust and civic engagement, utilizing heavy geometric typography, patriotic primary colors, and organic wave transitions to create a professional yet approachable presence.

## Estilo Visual
Create a visual style based on a tri-color institutional palette: Primary Blue (#004a8f), Accent Yellow (#fcd53f), and Secondary Green (#28a745). Typography must use Montserrat for all headings (Black/900 weight for hero, Bold/700 for subheaders) and Nunito (Regular/400 and Bold/700) for body copy. Headlines should have a tight line-height (1.1) and slightly compressed letter-spacing. Use 'Dancing Script' for rare handwriting accents. Apply a 'marker-underline' effect using a #fcd53f rectangle rotated -2 degrees behind text. Incorporate soft shadows (0 10px 15px -3px rgba(0,0,0,0.1)) for cards and badges. All section transitions should use layered SVG waves in Blue, Yellow, and Green.

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky Header
Design a sticky white header (py-4) with a flex layout. Left side: A vertically stacked logo using Montserrat Black, with 'Dra' (3xl) and 'Angela' (4xl) text, and a numeric indicator in yellow (#fcd53f). Right side: A two-line slogan in Primary Blue (#004a8f) using medium weights (sm and base sizes).

### Hero Section
A light-blue (#e6f0f9) hero section. Left-aligned content featuring triple-stacked headlines in Montserrat Black (7xl). Below headlines, place a white floating card (rounded-xl) with a thick left border (#fcd53f, 8px) containing the candidate's name and large number (5xl). The section must end with a 3-layered SVG wave footer using Green (#28a745), Yellow (#fcd53f), and Blue (#004a8f) in overlapping paths.

### Values Grid
A 2-column informational grid. Left column: Standard paragraph text in Nunito 1.125rem. Right column: A 2x2 bento-style icon grid. Each item features a circular icon container (64px) in either Blue, Yellow, or Green, followed by a Montserrat Bold header (xl) and Nunito sm body text.

### Proposals Section
A split section with a light-gray background (#f4f7fa). Left side: Large stylized typography rotated -3 degrees, featuring the marker-underline effect on key words. Right side: A vertical list of proposals. Each proposal uses a 64px blue circle with a white icon, a bold title, and secondary gray text (text-gray-600).

### CTA Area
A full-width high-contrast blue (#004a8f) section. Background must feature two large abstract circles: one green (#28a745) and one yellow (#fcd53f) partially clipped off-screen to the right. Content: Flex layout with a large WhatsApp logo, a white heading, and a pill-shaped yellow button (#fcd53f) with blue text and a message icon.

### Campaign Footer
A clean white footer with a 4-column grid layout. Column 1: Logo and candidate number. Column 2: Short mission statement with a blue left-border. Column 3: Contact/location icons. Column 4: Campaign CNPJ and legal naming. Final sub-footer: Dark blue bar with centered white 10px text.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Marker Underline — A highlight effect that mimics a physical highlighter marker.
Create a relative inline-block element. Use a ::after pseudo-element with absolute positioning at bottom: -2px, left: 0. Set width to 100%, height to 6px, background-color to #fcd53f, and transform: rotate(-2deg). Ensure z-index is -1 to place it behind the text.

### Candidate Number Badge — A high-visibility card for electoral identification.
White background container, rounded-xl (12px), shadow-lg. Add a border-left: 8px solid #fcd53f. Inside, use a horizontal flex layout containing the name (stacked Montserrat Bold) and the number (Montserrat Black, 3rem, #004a8f). Add a small PRD tag in 10px bold uppercase blue text at the bottom.

## Notas Especiais
Must-Dos: Use Montserrat Black (900) for all main numbers and names. Ensure the yellow #fcd53f is used only for highlights or primary buttons to maintain high contrast. Must-Nots: Avoid using sharp corners; prefer rounded-xl (12px to 16px). Do not use thin font weights for primary messaging; the brand identity relies on weight and thickness to convey strength.

style.description: The style essence is 'Institutional Boldness.' It relies on high-contrast primary colors and massive, heavy-weight sans-serif typography. Transitions between sections are softened using custom SVG organic curves rather than straight lines. Interactive elements utilize subtle hover shifts and clean icon sets.
